text: He’s been by the kitchen door since Mariupol. The cook dropped a pot lid and he didn’t even lift his head. Can we give him another minute?

Let him sleep. After your first win in Vinnytsia, each fireball on the Attack branch can hit up to two targets. On the Defense branch, every four aircraft you bring down will restore a tenth of his maximum health.
Is the enemy taking a break as well?
No. There are already jets and helicopters near the tower in Vinnytsia. Take a seat anyway, Bondarenko. While he sleeps, you might as well put your feet up.
